notes: Runs a DUAL-meter system: 'Actions' (platform runs, <$0.01 each) + 'Data Credits' (marketplace data/AI, from $0.05). This split appears to be a recent repricing — older third-party sources describe a single-credit system; effective date unverified, so recorded in notes rather than as a change event pending a source. On-page tile prices and FAQ prices conflict (Launch $167 tile vs $185 FAQ; Growth $446 vs $495) — both primary, both recorded.
